verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents programmatic, UI-free admin automation through its own Admin SDK REST APIs (Directory user listing, Reports API) and Apps Script automation of Admin console tasks, so the core of headless automation exists. Nothing covers CI pipelines, non-interactive or service-account authentication, or a CLI, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec. Apps Script is also a web-based environment rather than a CI runner. missing for 10: documented CI/headless runner or CLI, non-interactive service-account auth guidance, machine-readable API spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Anyone can use Apps Script to automate Admin console tasks in a web-based, low-code environment.
Retrieves a paginated list of either deleted users or all users in a domain.
The Admin SDK Reports API lets administrators of enterprise domains to view the audit and usage reports of their domain.
